subject.title: [RFC] Multi-Agent Collaboration Enhancement: Capability Profiling + Shared Blackboard + Layered Memory + Token Cost Governance

question: Which scoped OpenClaw-owned phase, if any, should move forward first for issue #35203?
rationale: The RFC crosses core/plugin API boundaries, persistent state, memory visibility, delegation policy, config shape, and cost governance, so automation cannot choose the product architecture or security model safely.

options.title: Approve a narrow design phase
options.body: Define the storage owner, security model, migration path, and first limited surface for performance records or budget guardrails before any implementation PR.

options.title: Prototype through plugin/API seams first
options.body: Keep core lean and require a plugin or ClawHub experiment unless it proves a missing OpenClaw extension API is blocking the feature.

options.title: Defer the full RFC
options.body: Leave #35203 open as a canonical discussion while narrower efforts such as #65403 or Mix Code Mode establish demand and safer primitives.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow design phase
recommendation.body: Define the storage owner, security model, migration path, and first limited surface for performance records or budget guardrails before any implementation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available owner signal from recent area history and related scoping comments.
